name: bind-keyboard-demo
//: Exists only so bundlers resolve sideEffects for demo/** from here rather than from the repo root. The root package.json is the published library and declares "sideEffects": false, which is true of src/** but not of this demo: demo/main.ts imports ./movement-game purely for its side effects, and a false declaration at the root silently tree-shook that whole module out of the production build. Declaring it true here scopes the exception to the demo without the root needing a wildcard array — Bun's bundler warns that wildcard sideEffects deoptimize the package entirely.
